buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Sample Clause After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 1 samples for Buyer's approval, within 5 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within 5 days of receipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Consignee. 3. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address 186 AWC Function in different Locations under Poshan Project Ramhall . 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms and Conditions:-

1. The procurement of Supplementary Nutrition shall be made in accordance with the Dece ntralized Policy for Procurement of Supplementary Nutrition under the Integrated Child Dev elopment Services (ICDS) Scheme, issued vide Government Order No. 44-SW of 2019 dated 29-01-2019, and the terms and conditions mentioned in Mission Director, Poshan J&K Order No. 60-MD of 2026 dated 05-02-2026 and in pursuance to directions conveyed by the admi nistrative department (SW) vide No. SWD/Actt/73/2024-02 (e-7586283) dated 24.08.2026. 2. Preference to Local Agencies: In accordance with the Decentralized Policy for Procur ement of Supplementary Nutrition under ICDS, issued vide Government Order No. 44-SW of 2019 dated 29-01-2019, followed by Government Order No. 141-JK(SWD) of 2024 dated 25- 07-2024, and the provisions relating to Local Filter Purchase for Difficult Areas, preference shall be given to local firms/supplying agencies such as Super Bazar, Cooperative Stores, Fi xed Price Shops, and Registered Local Shopkeepers operating at the decentralized level, pr ovided they fulfil the terms and conditions of the bid. 3. The products should have a detailed description, including the required nutritional value s, packaging details, batch numbers, manufacturing and expiry dates, and all other statuto ry details. 4. The items supplied must conform to the specified standards and specifications. 5. The supplying agency must supply the nutrition items strictly as per the approved specifi cations of the respective items. The brand must be FSSAI-certified/approved and fortified, Grade-1, with no compromise on the quality and specifications of the nutrition items. 6. Payments shall be released upon satisfactory delivery of the contracted nutrition items a nd shall be processed through BEAMS (SNA-SPARSH). 7. The bidder quoting the lowest rate (L1) and meeting the prescribed technical requireme nts shall ordinarily be considered for the award of the contract. The contract shall be finaliz ed only after approval of the samples submitted by the successful bidder within 02 days of the bid evaluation. 8. The rates quoted shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, transportation, and associate d charges, including freight charges up to the Anganwadi Centre level, as the supplier(s) sh all deliver the supplies directly to the (186) Anganwadi Centres across Poshan Project Ramh all against proper receipt and as per the approved indent. 9. Nutrition items such as Haldi and Salt shall not be delivered to the AWCs (Actual Locatio n of Delivery) in loose form. The required quantity shall be supplied in proper, sealed packa ging in accordance with the quantity required at the AWC level. 10. At the time of supply, all items must have a shelf life of at least six months from the da te of receipt at the Anganwadi Centre, except for items having an approved shelf life of les s than six months, in which case the maximum approved shelf life shall be applicable. 11. A fine/penalty shall be imposed in accordance with the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, and the rules/regulations made thereunder, up to the maximum permissible amount, if any violation of prescribed norms or quality standards is found at any stage. 12. The supplier must comply with all applicable local, State, and Central laws and regulati ons, including applicable labour laws and non-discrimination provisions, and shall ensure o pen and fair competition. 13. The supplying agency should have suitable premises/shops available for pre-procurem ent inspection, inspection during procurement, and inspection of the quality and quantity o f all nutritional items at any stage of the procurement process. 14. A Bank Guarantee or Security Deposit equivalent to 0.05% of the contracted value shal l be deposited by the successful supplier. The same shall be released three months after th e successful completion of supplies at the Anganwadi Centre(s) level. The Bank Guarantee/ Security Deposit shall be liable to forfeiture if the supplier fails to deliver the supplies within the specified period or if the supplies are found to be substandard or expired.

15. The supplier(s) shall supply the nutritional items to the AWCs within seven (07) days fr om the date of receipt of the supply order/contract, or within the period prescribed under th e applicable GeM rules, as the case may be. 16. The supplier(s) should not be under liquidation, court receivership, or any similar proce edings and should not have been declared bankrupt or insolvent. 17. The supplier(s) shall supply the nutritional items along with the requisite quality certific ate. Random testing of the nutritional items may be conducted by the Food Safety Departm ent at any stage. 18. The supplier(s) must possess a valid FSSAI certificate/license and GST Registration. In addition, cooperative societies shall submit their Registration Certificate, approved by-laws, and a Functionality Certificate issued by the concerned competent authority. 19. The supplier(s) shall submit an affidavit stating that the firm/supplying agency, includin g Super Bazar/Cooperative Stores/Fixed Price Shops/Registered Local Shopkeepers or any o ther eligible agency, has not been blacklisted by any Government or Semi-Government aut hority. 20. The supplier(s) shall warrant that the goods supplied conform to the prescribed descrip tions and specifications, are free from defects, are of satisfactory quality, and are fit for the intended purpose, i.e., human consumption. 21. This office reserves the right to accept or reject any bid and/or to withdraw or cancel th e contract, with specific reason(s), at any stage as deemed appropriate. 22. The tentative requirement is enclosed as Annexure-A. 23Here is a more professional and grammatically corrected version: 24.Due to an incorrect estimation of the quantities of the following fou r (04) items, namely Moongi Green, Haldi, Salt, and Skimmed Milk, a ll bidders are hereby informed that the previous bid shall not be consi dered for these above mentioned 04 items. All interested bidders, incl uding those who participated in the previous bidding process for these four items, are welcome to participate in the fresh bidding process. .
